headline: Prepare every claim for the right human review
capabilities: Classify and route claims instantly to automated or human workflows
Flag suspected fraud early and generate SIU evidence packages
Pre‑analyze complex claims and highlight missing documents
Auto‑generate approval or denial recommendations aligned with guidelines
outcomes: Cut processing time dramatically with automated workflows
Reduced fraud exposure with earlier detection and SIU referrals
Accelerated adjudication with ready‑for‑review claim files
Improved service quality with faster decisions and communications
why_try: A claims manager can ask which file needs attention and see the exact synthetic claim, missing evidence, SIU indicator, policy term, and next review checkpoint.

sample_prompts.label: Claims intake triage
sample_prompts.prompt: Process the incoming claims queue and identify which ones need immediate attention vs auto-adjudication.

sample_prompts.label: Claim-file readiness
sample_prompts.prompt: What is missing from Jennifer Liu’s theft file before I can evaluate it?

sample_prompts.label: SIU indicator review
sample_prompts.prompt: Yes, show me the fraud detection results and high-risk claims.

sample_prompts.label: Policy-term settlement estimate
sample_prompts.prompt: Show the policy-term estimates and state clearly whether any claim was approved or paid.

sample_prompts.label: Auto-adjudication recommendations
sample_prompts.prompt: Yes, auto-adjudicate the eligible claims and show me the results.

sample_prompts.label: Processing metrics and improvements
sample_prompts.prompt: Yes, show me the metrics and where we can improve further.

sample_prompts.label: Session summary
sample_prompts.prompt: Yes, summarize everything we accomplished today.

business_flow: SharePoint or approved claims document repository
